item.title: Mega real estate brokerages raise the stakes in the war for agents
item.description: The Compass-Anywhere merger has led to new recruitment and retention strategies among independent brokerages as market share consolidates.

item.title: Experian to acquire mortgage shopping platform Own Up
item.description: Consumer credit reporting company Experian has reached an agreement to acquire mortgage shopping platform Own Up, with the goal of integrating homebuying guidance and loan options into its ecosystem.

item.title: Will steady mortgage rates calm buyers and sellers this spring?
item.description: Mortgage rates are stable near 6.2% after the Fed’s decision, with spring housing activity hinging on jobs and inflation trends.

item.title: Purlin and Final Offer merge to launch unified AI real estate platform
item.description: Purlin and Final Offer merged to form an AI platform uniting real estate, mortgage and title, serving 35,000 agents and 15 million consumers.

item.title: BPC Action presses Congress to advance bipartisan housing bills
item.description: BPC Action calls for swift votes on bills targeting regulatory reforms and affordable housing development nationwide.

item.description: An exclusive report published Tuesday by Bloomberg describes an ambitious proposal reportedly being developed by U.S. homebuilders: a massive, privately funded rent-to-own initiative branded internally as “Trump Homes,” potentially delivering up to one million houses and more than $250 billion in housing value. item.title: Beazer pivots to a mix-shift into higher-margin homes after a Q1 loss
item.description: Beazer Homes reported a $32.6M loss and 14% gross margin as it pivots to higher-priced, energy-efficient homes for 2026.

item.title: Bed Bath & Beyond parent eyes mortgages through deals with Figure, Tokens.com
item.description: Bed Bath & Beyond’s parent company has reached an agreement to acquire Tokens.com as part of its plan to launch an investment and personal finance platform, which will also offer home loans through a partnership with Figure Technologies.

item.title: Home equity is still strong despite dipping in Q4 2025
item.description: ATTOM reports U.S. homeowner equity dipped in late 2025, but levels remain strong compared to pre-pandemic years.

item.title: New app blurs the social media, MLS line
item.description: The Tuesday app is intended to simplify how users interact with MLS information — letting agents follow other agents, track listings and more.
